camera: Flat front-facing UI, no 3D previews or parallax.

hudLayout.topThird: Top ~0-5%: a black band at top-left where the chapter book should be (missing header). Top-right a grey header strip with three dark grey counter slots: hexagonal gold coin 25, green star 0, magenta meeple 123. No quest bar visible. From ~7% a large khaki parchment panel begins, spanning ~93% of width with a thin margin on a dark navy backdrop; the first two rows of the grid sit in this third.
hudLayout.middleThird: A 6-column grid of small square grey item tiles, each tile slightly rotated at a random small angle like a scattered card, with a soft drop shadow down-right and a purple-tinted top edge. Eight rows: rows 1-7 have 6 tiles, row 8 has 5 tiles (left-aligned). Almost every tile is an unknown slot showing a grey '?' on a lighter inset square. Two tiles are revealed: row 5 column 6 shows a bunch of orange carrots with '29'; row 6 column 2 shows purple-white turnips with '48'. The grid fills ~8% to ~70% of the screen height.
hudLayout.bottomThird: The lower part of the khaki panel (~70-90%) is empty parchment. Below the panel at ~94-100%: a dark wood plank strip with a wide chunky amber-orange button 'NEXT' centred. Debug text 'fps: 60.02' bottom-left.

keyElements: large khaki panel filling most of the screen
6-column grid of rotated square item tiles, 47 tiles
amber 'NEXT' button bottom-centre on a wood strip
uiStyle: One flat khaki panel with a darker bottom lip; small grey slab tiles with a rounded bevel and a hard soft-brown drop shadow, scattered at slight tilts; glossy painted item icons with white bold count numbers; chunky amber 9-slice button.
colorPalette: Dominant warm khaki parchment field with many muted cool-grey tiles, two saturated item accents (orange carrot, purple turnip), dark navy margins and a brown wood strip with a bright amber button.
mood: A tidy end-of-chapter tally — the haul being counted and sold off.
composition: A dense uniform grid dominates; the eye goes to the two coloured item tiles and then down through the empty parchment to the NEXT button.
